title: Capture UTM parameters into lead metadata + feature flag for ABM form routing
author: Tyler Benson
description:
Context: For the regulated workloads ABM pilot we need reliable attribution from vertical landing pages (FinServ/Healthcare) through HubSpot. Today, the form submission payload only captures the explicit form fields; UTMs live in the browser URL and are lost once users navigate, and we have no safe kill switch for the new routing rules that will send leads to different HubSpot pipelines/Slack channels.

This PR adds (1) lightweight client-side capture of a small allowlisted set of attribution params and (2) a server-side feature flag for ABM form routing. Both are designed to be privacy-safe and to avoid storing full URLs or arbitrary query strings.

What changed:
- UTM capture (client): On first page load we capture allowlisted parameters and store them in a short-lived first-party cookie (7 days) + sessionStorage fallback.
  - allowlist: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content, gclid, msclkid
  - additional context: initial_referrer (hostname only), initial_landing_path (path only, no query)
  - we DO NOT store the full URL, full referrer, or arbitrary query params.
- Lead metadata (server): Form submissions now include an `attribution` object flattened into lead metadata keys sent to HubSpot + internal lead logs. Metadata keys are prefixed to avoid collisions (e.g., attribution_utm_source).
- Feature flag: Adds `abm_form_routing_v1` (default OFF) that gates the new routing rules for regulated workload landing pages. When OFF, routing behavior remains unchanged.
- Dedupe: Adds a stable `lead_submission_id` (uuid v4) to help Sales Ops dedupe multi-submit scenarios (refresh/Back button) in HubSpot.

Security/privacy notes:
- Query-string parsing uses a strict allowlist; everything else is ignored.
- Cookie is scoped to `SameSite=Lax`, `Secure` in production; no PII expected in the captured values.
- Referrer is reduced to hostname only and only captured on the first touch.

Testing:
- Unit: added tests for allowlist parsing + hostname normalization.
- Manual: verified on local landing page that UTMs persist across navigation to /demo, and that payload includes attribution_* keys when submitting the form.

Rollout plan:
- Merge behind flag, deploy.
- Enable `abm_form_routing_v1` for 10% of traffic on /regulated/* and validate HubSpot properties populate as expected.
- If any issues, disable the flag (server-side) and attribution capture continues to be safe/no-op for routing.

Notes: This is intentionally minimal instrumentation (no new vendor SDK). It’s meant to bridge the ABM pilot until we finalize end-to-end reporting fields per PM-482.

Screenshots/verification: See attached console logs in the PR discussion; HubSpot test submission IDs are in #marketing-ops (internal).
commits: web: capture allowlisted UTM params on first touch and persist (cookie + sessionStorage)
leads: plumb attribution metadata through form submission handler
config: add abm_form_routing_v1 feature flag and default to off
tests: add UTM parsing and referrer hostname normalization coverage
docs: dev note for local testing and how to toggle the flag
conversation:
Ben Carter (review): Can we make sure we’re not capturing the entire referrer URL? We’ve seen prospects with internal paths in referers during security review. Also can we include gclid/msclkid while we’re here?

Tyler Benson (author): Yep. Updated to capture referrer hostname only + path-only for the landing page (no query). Also expanded allowlist to include gclid/msclkid and added tests.

Marcus Lin (review): Please confirm cookie flags: Secure in prod, SameSite=Lax, and keep retention short. Also avoid logging raw attribution at INFO.

Tyler Benson (author): Cookie flags added; retention 7 days. Lead logs now store attribution_* keys at DEBUG only; production default keeps DEBUG off. No raw URL logging.

Isabelle Laurent (review): For reporting, can we standardize property names to avoid HubSpot having multiple variants? I’d prefer attribution_utm_campaign etc. Also include a submission UUID for dedupe.

Tyler Benson (author): Standardized prefix to attribution_* and added lead_submission_id. HubSpot mapping updated.

Soojin Lee (review): Please add a short rollout note in the PR description + confirm this doesn’t imply we can do “advanced attribution” beyond UTMs.

Tyler Benson (author): Added rollout plan and clarified scope (minimal, allowlisted UTMs only).

Approvals:
- Ben Carter: Approved
- Marcus Lin: Approved (with cookie/referrer constraints addressed)
- Isabelle Laurent: Approved
- Soojin Lee: Approved

Merged via squash on 2026-01-27.
release_notes: Internal: ABM landing page submissions now capture allowlisted UTM attribution into lead metadata; added server-side feature flag `abm_form_routing_v1` to safely roll out routing behavior.
